title: Steve Jobs Presents to the Cupertino City Council  (6/7/11)
summary: Steve Jobs presents Apple's proposal for a new campus to the Cupertino City Council in June 2011, answering council members' questions about the plan.
why: HN returns to it as a primary source for campus details, Jobs's answers on taxes and on-site power, and the council's offbeat requests.

quote.text: This reminds me how Steve Jobs answered the question about how city residents will benefit from their new campus (2011)
